AGENT CITY

REAL AGENTS. VISIBLE WORK.

# Production Notes

## Composition Contract

- Composition ID: `agent-city-title-card`
- Timed clip ID: `agent-city-main-clip`
- Canvas: 640 × 360
- Planned frame rate: 30 fps
- Duration: 6 seconds / 180 frames
- Audio: none
- Runtime dependencies supplied by runtime: GSAP 3.13.0 and HyperFrames 0.8.141
- External assets: none

## Implementation

The composition uses one six-second timed clip containing original SVG border geometry and the two approved text elements. The background is solid navy, the border is bright blue, and all text is white using the generic `monospace` family.

The paused GSAP timeline is registered as `window.__timelines["agent-city-title-card"]`. It contains no wall-clock timers or CSS animations.

## Timing

- 0.000–0.500 seconds / frames 0–14: the SVG border draws on while `AGENT CITY` settles from an eight-pixel vertical offset and zero opacity.
- 0.500–2.000 seconds / frames 15–59: the completed title and border hold without motion.
- 2.000–2.300 seconds / frames 60–68: `REAL AGENTS. VISIBLE WORK.` settles from an eight-pixel vertical offset and zero opacity.
- Frame 69 onward: both approved lines and the completed border remain visible through the final frame.

## Repair Provenance

The preceding attempt failed before rendering in the network-disabled Workcell because HyperFrames 0.8.141 reported `font_family_without_font_face` for `sfmono-regular` (CI37801961320; Workcell `wc-9003cf561a9948d7a527941193749d11`). This revision replaces the named platform-font stack with the permitted generic `monospace` family and adds the stable ID `agent-city-main-clip` to the timed clip to address the `studio_missing_editable_id` warning. Copy, timing, geometry, colors, motion, and asset scope are otherwise unchanged.

## Copy Verification

Visible copy is limited to:

- `AGENT CITY`
- `REAL AGENTS. VISIBLE WORK.`

Capitalization and punctuation match the supplied transcript. No labels, claims, logos, or additional supporting copy were introduced.

## Asset and Scope Verification

No remote URLs, downloaded fonts, packages, images, audio, or undocumented media are referenced. The empty asset manifest is respected. The implementation does not alter the supplied transcript or shot timing.

## Downstream Status

The earlier attempt did not render. This revised artifact has not yet undergone runtime technical checks, rendering, media probing, checksum recording, or perceptual and independent exact-candidate review. No successful render, approval, `draft.mp4`, or `final.mp4` is claimed.
